standard_prerequisites: Standard local-cohomology depth and support comparison, dualizing-complex dimension functions and semicontinuity, and the cited annihilator theorem. The actual common-ideal closure/refinement is part of the counted author proof.
core_obligations: a) 实质要求：设 I,J 是 Noether 环 A 的理想、M 是有限 A-模、s,d 是整数；在四条假定（A 有对偶复形；p in V(I) 无条件；p notin V(I) 且 p in T 时有维数界；p notin V(I) 且 p notin T 时有 depth 或 depth+维数的下界）下，给出相应的消没结论（kill 型）。b) 允许引用：证明内逐处引用的既有局部上同调/对偶理论（algebraization 篇内）。c) 必须由本证明完成的部分：按 p 所属情形逐支核对 depth 与维数条件并推出消没。d) 原文定位：algebraization.tex 1924-1952（陈述）、1954-2061（证明）。判 H2：kill-colimit 型技术引理，机制为条件核对与既有理论拼装，第 (iii) 条不满足。未逐行读，建议复核。
difficulty_reason: H2: Stability and bounded-degree annihilation of uncompleted local cohomology after choosing an ideal J0 under the original depth/dimension conditions. Given local-cohomology depth/annihilator results, the author still constructs J0 from the closure of low-depth primes in the specialization-stable support T, handles new generic points of this closure using an infinite-prime/dimension-function semicontinuity argument, and refines the ideal without changing its intersection with V(I). This constructs the required common stable ideal, not merely checks a pre-existing criterion. Unlike existing099, no I-adic completeness or derived-completion target is assumed; unlike existing310/2090, the target includes stability for all smaller supports with the fixed V(I) intersection. Count this complete ideal-control result once; original short inadequate difficulty note retained.

dedup.basis: Here the uncompleted support-to-support maps stabilise simultaneously after an explicitly selected ideal and the low-degree groups have power annihilation. Existing completion/model and annihilator statements have different assumptions/outputs; proof-input overlap is not asserted to be an identical counted proposition.
